description: Figure 2 is a pie chart that illustrates the taxonomy on medical ethics. The inner circle of the pie chart is divided into four segments, each representing one of the four pillar principles in medicine. The outer circle of the pie chart is divided into 26 segments, each representing one of the 26 categories clustered from 256 detailed principles. The chart does not include any percentage labels or other annotations.
